PRINTABLE ANIMAL CARDS

Animal Flashcards: print all twelve cards

Twelve animal cards, two to a printed page — twelve friends from dog to bird, each with its sound to make.

Made for age 3 and up — one clear picture per card, animals kept in card order. The cards print in card order — cut them out or use them as they are. When you are ready, choose Print Cards.

Back to class ↗

Printing happens in your browser — nothing is uploaded and nothing is installed. No PDF is involved.
